children: Cactus Acquisition Corp. 1 Ltd reported a wider net loss for first-quarter 2026, posting a loss of $168K versus a $78K loss in the year-ago quarter, driven primarily by lower interest income from its trust account as the company remains a blank‑check SPAC without operating revenue.
Net income: $(168K) for Q1 2026, versus $(78K) in Q1 2025 (wider loss of $90K YoY), primarily due to lower trust-account interest.
Diluted EPS: Reported as (loss) per non-redeemable share of $(0.05) for Q1 2026 vs $(0.04) for Q1 2025.
Revenue: No operating revenue reported for Q1 2026 or Q1 2025 (company is a blank‑check SPAC; income is investment interest).
Business Combination Progress: The company is executing a definitive business combination agreement with Tembo; an F-4 has been filed and is under SEC review with a planned resubmission in H2 2026.
Operational Focus: Continued search and due diligence on target completion, working toward closing before mandatory liquidation on Nov. 2, 2026.
Trading & Market Access: Delisted from Nasdaq in Nov. 2024 and trading on the OTC market; management plans a Nasdaq uplisting after completing the business combination.
Operational Runway: The company is relying on third‑party promissory funding to sustain deal execution and transaction-related activities.
